purpose: An inherited-pending ancestor sends to an owning detached middle. The normal ignored-argument destructor mutates a raw reference row after the API snapshots it; the return and snapshot alias the old array while getters follow the COW row.
source:
<?php
class ReviewPendingChainOld31 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewPendingChainNew31 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewPendingChainArg31 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; $GLOBALS["row"][0] = new ReviewPendingChainNew31(); echo "W|"; } }
function &reviewPendingChainChild31() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewPendingChainOld31()]; echo "C|"; yield $row; echo "L|"; return $row; }
function reviewPendingChainMiddle31() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewPendingChainUpper31() { try { echo "U|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewPendingChainOuter31() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = reviewPendingChainChild31(); $middle = reviewPendingChainMiddle31(); $upper = reviewPendingChainUpper31(); $outer = reviewPendingChainOuter31();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewPendingChainOld31 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
$snapshot = $upper->send(new ReviewPendingChainArg31()); echo "CALLER|", $snapshot[0] instanceof ReviewPendingChainOld31 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewPendingChainNew31 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($row); echo "ROW|"; unset($snapshot); echo "SNAP|"; echo "E";

purpose: A present-null ancestor SEND leaves the owning returned array separate from the ignored argument. Physical close and a later global shared-cell write distinguish the retained container from its mutable old and new referents.
source:
<?php
class ReviewPendingChainCellOld31 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class ReviewPendingChainCellNew31 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
class ReviewPendingChainCellArg31 { function __destruct() { echo "ARG|"; } }
function reviewPendingChainCellChild31() { global $slot; echo "C|"; yield null; echo "L|"; $slot = new ReviewPendingChainCellOld31(); return [&$slot]; }
function reviewPendingChainCellMiddle31() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewPendingChainCellUpper31() { try { echo "U|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewPendingChainCellOuter31() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = reviewPendingChainCellChild31(); $middle = reviewPendingChainCellMiddle31(); $upper = reviewPendingChainCellUpper31(); $outer = reviewPendingChainCellOuter31();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
$snapshot = $upper->send(new ReviewPendingChainCellArg31()); echo "CALLER|", $snapshot === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($snapshot); echo "EX|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|";
$slot = new ReviewPendingChainCellNew31(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|"; echo "E";
